scope: Read-only review of actual Minecraft preflight originals, not projection images. No production changes.

observations.balanced_case01: Rear cap clearly slopes down/back, short temple fins remain attached outside original head. Back view shows symmetric fins and intact blue wings and tail, with visible separation between head/cap and body appendages. No exposed internal air gap observed.
observations.run_case02: Long posterior cap points up/back as intended; paired short fins tilt upward/outward from temple. Back view shows symmetric raised fins, unchanged box head, and visible wing/tail attachments. No visible cap/orb/wing clipping in sampled views.
observations.pure_swim_case04: Front shows symmetric hanging fins outside eyes and original rectangular head/face. Side shows long descending rear cap and pale fin faces, with connected two-section joints. Fin and hood remain behind/above compact hand; back shows clear blue wing/tail attachments and symmetric rear silhouette. No eye, hand, foot, orb or wing penetration observed in these sampled frames.
observations.book_case14: Nine selected original frames span front t12/t36/t48, left t72/t96/t108 and back t132/t156/t180. Original open eyes and happy closed expression render; book is held across palms, page-turn visible, both hands remain compact/coherent. The medium hanging fins are above/behind the forearms; rear cap remains clear of wing/tail, no cap-arm or fin-book clipping observed. Head tilts follow shared rig.
observations.construction_style: Blocky original head box retained; three stepped cap blocks and two fin blocks per side produce a deliberately simple Minecraft interpretation. Broad posterior rectangular hem remains the documented silhouette approximation.

qualifications: Inspection covers these16 still frames, not all195preflight captures or a continuous motion recording.
